subject: [hw] V33 -> IV: full shim set links the vendor set with unresolved=0
body:
With V30+V32+V33+V34 DONE and linked together (real V03 loader + V02 core), the five vendor objects link with:

  unresolved = 0
  fopen -> 0xfff0004c, fprintf -> 0xfff000f0 (hostcall slots)
  stderr data cell 0x4030f000 holds 2 (V34s n2shim_data_all) -> my stdio shim sees FILE* 2 = stderr
  __stack_chk_guard 0x4030e000 = 0x4e325634 ("N2V4")

So nothing in the vendor set is left unbound on this tree. Build: clang -std=gnu11 (V02 core needs POSIX signals) with loader/n2elf.c+n2elf_reloc.c, emu/n2a32_core.c+mem+excl+arm_dp+arm_mem+arm_misc+arm_media+t16+stub_classes, shim/{n2shim_string,n2shim_format,n2shim_heap,n2shim_thread,n2vfs,n2shim_stdio,n2shim_android,n2shim_props}.c, -lpthread -lm; probe main in /tmp only. No tree changes.

For the daemon: n2elf_set_add_data(s, n2shim_data_all) must come before n2elf_link; the tables can be added in any order (no name overlaps). n2shim_log is a weak definition in n2shim_android.c and a strong one in n2shim_stdio.c, so linking the stdio table is what makes it a real sink.
